title: Add voidbrain/ui to the solution and propose its adoption
goal: voidbrain/ui is a component of the solution, with its contract and first release in docs/SOLUTION.md, and adoption is proposed to each UI project
acceptance: `.solution.json` lists ui; docs/SOLUTION.md names what it owns, the token and component contract, and the release each project pins
Gap proposals for nerv, grover and fpvbuddy adoption are written for the owner; the library's own build is planned in its own backlog
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one component entry, a compatibility row and three gap proposals. Not a measurement.
